desc: Decompose $S$ into primitive components using a balance counter (split whenever balance returns to 0).
Count the frequency of each unique primitive component string.
Precompute factorials and inverse factorials modulo 998244353.
Calculate the multinomial coefficient $\frac{k!}{c_1! c_2! \dots c_m!}$ where $k$ is the total number of components and $c_i$ are the counts of each unique component.
Run the code against the provided sample inputs to verify correctness.
